readback.name: Poincare.HamiltonScalarGradientEstimate.cubic_reaction_le_four_scalar_mul_traceless
readback.mathematical_statement: For a Hausdorff smooth boundaryless three-dimensional charted space M with smooth Riemannian metric g and the recorded C1 regularity instance for its canonical Levi-Civita connection, fix x and write A for the Ricci endomorphism at x, R = tr(A), N = tr(A squared), and C = tr(A cubed). If R > 0 and N / R squared <= 1, then (10 R N - 2 R cubed - 8 C) - (4/3) R N <= 4 R (N - R squared/3). Equivalently, (26/3) R N - 2 R cubed - 8 C <= 4 R times the squared norm of traceless Ricci. Both sides are the repository pointwise invariant algebraic expressions; no Ricci-flow solution or parabolic evolution identity is assumed or concluded. The pinching assumption is the stated quotient bound, not a requirement that every Ricci eigenvalue be positive. No compactness or connectedness hypothesis appears in the exact type.
